program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let ((seeds (filter (lambda (cell) (and (not (= (third cell) 0)) (not (= (third cell) 5))))
                       (grid-cells g))))
    (define (shortest-distance r c seed)
      (let ((visited (make-hash)))
        (let bfs ([queue (list (list r c 0))])
          (cond [(empty? queue) 999]
                [else
                 (let* ((cur (first queue))
                        (rr (first cur))
                        (cc (second cur))
                        (dist (third cur))
                        (restq (rest queue)))
                   (cond [(hash-has-key? visited (list rr cc)) (bfs restq)]
                         [(not (in-bounds? rr cc (rows g) (cols g))) (bfs restq)]
                         [(= (at g rr cc) 5) (bfs restq)]
                         [(and (= rr (first seed)) (= cc (second seed))) dist]
                         [else
                          (hash-set! visited (list rr cc) #t)
                          (bfs (append restq
                                       (map (lambda (d)
                                              (list (+ rr (first d)) (+ cc (second d)) (+ dist 1)))
                                            cardinal-deltas)))]))]))))
    (define (fill-value r c)
      (let* ((distances (map (lambda (seed) (list (shortest-distance r c seed) (third seed))) seeds))
             (dmin (apply min (map first distances)))
             (colors (remove-duplicates (map second (filter (lambda (x) (= (first x) dmin)) distances)))))
        (if (and (< dmin 999) (= (length colors) 1)) (first colors) 0)))
    (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
      (lambda (r c)
        (if (and (= (at g r c) 0) (not (= (at g r c) 5)))
            (fill-value r c)
            (at g r c))))))
